mapper.select: SELECT s.stock_name AS "name", s.stock_code AS "code", a.quantity AS "shares", a.purchase_amount AS "buyPrice", a.avg_price AS "avgBuyPrice" FROM asset a JOIN stock s ON a.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT s.stock_name AS "name", so.quantity AS "shares", a.avg_price AS "buyPrice", so.order_price AS "sellPrice", (so.order_price - a.avg_price) * so.quantity AS "profit", ROUND(((so.order_price - a.avg_price) / a.avg_price) * 100, 2) AS "profitRate", so.updated_at AS "tradeDate" FROM stock_order so JOIN stock s ON so.stock_code = s.stock_code LEFT JOIN asset a ON so.account_id = a.account_id AND so.stock_code = a.stock_code WHERE so.account_id = #{accountId} AND so.transaction_type = 'SELL' AND so.status = 'COMPLETED'
AND so.updated_at >= #{startDate}
AND so.updated_at <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
ORDER BY so.updated_at DESC

SELECT s.stock_name AS "stockName", s.stock_code AS "stockCode", o.quantity AS "orderQty", o.order_price AS "orderPrice", o.transaction_type AS "type", (o.quantity * o.order_price) AS "orderAmount", /* MySQL: DATE_FORMAT 사용 (시:분:초) */ DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%H:%i:%s') AS "orderTime", COALESCE(t.total_qty, 0) AS "executedQty", (o.quantity - COALESCE(t.total_qty, 0)) AS "unexecutedQty", ((o.quantity - COALESCE(t.total_qty, 0)) * o.order_price) AS "unexecutedAmount", t.avg_price AS "executedPrice", /* MySQL: DATE_FORMAT 사용 */ DATE_FORMAT(o.updated_at, '%H:%i:%s') AS "executedTime" FROM stock_order o JOIN stock s ON o.stock_code = s.stock_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, SUM(trade_quantity) as total_qty, AVG(trade_price) as avg_price FROM trade_log GROUP BY order_id ) t ON o.order_id = t.order_id WHERE o.account_id = #{accountId} /* MySQL: STR_TO_DATE 사용 및 날짜 비교 */ AND o.created_at >= STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND o.created_at < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT m.nickname AS "nickname", a.account_number AS "accountNumber", a.balance AS "balance", a.account_created_at AS "createdAt" FROM account a JOIN member m ON a.user_id = m.user_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}
